This data mining includes a preview of possible rewards in Season 17 (from June 2024), which can be read on the current PTS. Actual rewards may change between now and then.

Fallout 1st Survival Tent "Vintage Camper"

In Season 17 you will receive a new survival tent as a reward. The current English name is “Vintage Camper”. Inside you'll find a stash box, ammo box, salvage box and even a punch card machine to change your loadout!
